actions: elevates the scapula, assists downward rotation

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Named literally for its action; runs from the upper 4 cervical transverse processes down to the scapula's superior angle, often a site of tension/trigger points from prolonged neck postures.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

motor_endplate_zones.method: whole-mount nerve staining, intramuscular arborization mapping
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Innervated by the posterior rami of C3-C5. Most intramuscular nerve terminals fall in the middle 40% of the muscle's length; the authors note this band corresponds surface-wise to roughly the level of the cricoid cartilage (C6).
motor_endplate_zones.source: Lee JH, Lee KW, Yi KH, Lee HJ, 'Anatomical analysis of the intramuscular distribution patterns of the levator scapulae and the clinical implications for pain management', Surg Radiol Anat 45(7):859 (2023), doi:10.1007/s00276-023-03146-3 -- 20 levator scapulae from 16 Korean cadavers, whole-mount nerve staining. Retrieved via PubMed.

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)
